hypothesis: When canonical candidate eligibility and every non-ranking condition are held fixed, continuous point-in-time leadership and setup-quality rankings may allocate scarce portfolio heat differently from production Final Score.

eligibility.source: caller-supplied canonical eligibility and blocked reason
eligibility.rule: freeze once before ranking; rankers cannot add, remove, or repair eligible candidates

factor_formulas.recent_rs_score: causal cross-sectional weighted price-relative-strength percentile using 5, 20, 60, and 126-session returns
factor_formulas.industry_proxy_score: causal industry-relative score from bars through the as-of date; classification provenance must be disclosed
factor_formulas.pivot_supply_quality_score: 10 minus pivot_supply_days_10d, where the latter counts distribution days near the causal 126-session pivot

missing_factor_policy: coerce NaN, positive infinity, and negative infinity to missing; preserve missing in raw audit and assign percentile 0, so missing ranks last without changing eligibility

weights.leave_one_out: exactly one third for each remaining factor

portfolio_evaluation.state_rule: accepted positions retain allocated heat through their effective exit; blocked candidates remain rejected
portfolio_evaluation.common_conditions: risk, total heat, maximum positions, industry cap, execution, exit, costs, and market/regime limits are supplied once and shared unchanged by all arms
portfolio_evaluation.variable_heat_support: an optional point-in-time effective-heat column is capped by the common portfolio ceiling and applied identically to every arm

runner_contract.interpretation: candidate_risk_r and effective_heat_limit_r must be captured before allocation from the unchanged canonical state; the 3.0R value is only the existing absolute ceiling and does not replace the row's effective regime heat limit

portfolio_metrics: accepted and mature accepted episode counts
average and peak portfolio heat R

stage_boundary_policy.membership: signal date must fall inside the stage window
stage_boundary_policy.future_entry: a plan entry after outcomes_observed_through is not observable and remains unselected for that stage
stage_boundary_policy.crossing_exit: a plan exit after outcomes_observed_through is censored to open at the cutoff; realised R, MFE, MAE, and holding sessions are null and cannot count as mature
stage_boundary_policy.portfolio_state: a position open at the cutoff continues consuming heat through the cutoff

phase_b_advancement_gate.purpose: produce at most a two-ranker shortlist for human review; never name or promote a champion automatically
phase_b_advancement_gate.sample_floor_scope: production baseline and every challenger must independently meet the floor in every required stage
secondary_requirements: total_realised_r strictly greater than production_final_score in both stages
profit_factor not below production_final_score in either stage
maximum_drawdown_r no more than 1.0R worse than production_final_score in either stage
phase_b_advancement_gate.holdout_policy: the Phase A shortlist cannot inspect the holdout; access requires a separately preregistered Phase B protocol

runner.input_contract: one point-in-time pre-allocation candidate row per as_of_date/ticker with frozen eligibility, original risk, heat limit, Final Score, Industry, Sector, Industry Composite Score, and frozen plan outcome fields
runner.engineering_replay_policy: explicit --engineering-replay may exercise the pipeline outside formal periods but cannot apply the advancement gate or provide validation evidence

required_before_enablement: durable adjusted OHLCV and benchmark archives with source/as-of provenance
verified formal classification loader and regression coverage

data_gate: Point-in-time universe, classification, factor, price, and execution provenance remain mandatory. Current local historical data is NOT_READY.
